data.title: The order beside the till

memoryNodes.cue: Lin has a spending limit and a particular use in mind.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林有支出上限，也有具体用途。

memoryNodes.cue: Part of the price is paid before the item arrives.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 物品到货前已支付部分价格。

memoryNodes.cue: Lin asks about extra costs and pays the first amount.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林询问额外费用，并支付第一笔款。

data.situation:
After the building visit, Lin stopped at the shop with a list for the centre’s new tea corner. Her budget allowed forty pounds for a kettle. The assistant showed her two models and an order form for the one not yet in stock. Lin chose that model because its wider handle was preferable for the way the team planned to use it. She put the form beside the till and asked about the price. Assistant: The kettle is forty pounds. We ask for a ten-pound deposit when you order it, and you pay the rest when it arrives.
Lin: Do you charge extra for delivery?
Assistant: Yes. Delivery is five pounds, or you can collect it here.
Lin: I will collect it. Can I pay the deposit by credit card?
Assistant: Yes. I will mark the amount paid on the order form. Kettle order
Price: £40
Deposit paid: £10
Balance on collection: £30
Collection: contact us when the arrival message reaches you
Lin folded the form and kept it with the centre’s shopping list. The tea corner would have to wait a few more days.

readingBlocks.en: After the building visit, Lin stopped at the shop with a list for the centre’s new tea corner. Her budget allowed forty pounds for a kettle. The assistant showed her two models and an order form for the one not yet in stock. Lin chose that model because its wider handle was preferable for the way the team planned to use it. She put the form beside the till and asked about the price.
readingBlocks.zh: 参观建筑后，林带着中心新茶角的清单去商店。预算中留了四十英镑买水壶。助手给她看两种型号，并拿出尚未到货型号的订单。林选了那一种，因为较宽的把手更适合团队计划的用途。她把表格放到收银台旁，询问价格。

readingBlocks.en:
Assistant: The kettle is forty pounds. We ask for a ten-pound deposit when you order it, and you pay the rest when it arrives.
Lin: Do you charge extra for delivery?
Assistant: Yes. Delivery is five pounds, or you can collect it here.
Lin: I will collect it. Can I pay the deposit by credit card?
Assistant: Yes. I will mark the amount paid on the order form.
readingBlocks.zh:
助手：水壶四十英镑。订货时付十英镑定金，到货后付剩余的钱。
林：送货另外收费吗？
助手：是，送货五英镑，也可以来店自取。
林：我来取，能用信用卡付定金吗？
助手：能。我会把已付金额标在订单上。

readingBlocks.en:
Kettle order
Price: £40
Deposit paid: £10
Balance on collection: £30
Collection: contact us when the arrival message reaches you
Lin folded the form and kept it with the centre’s shopping list. The tea corner would have to wait a few more days.
readingBlocks.zh:
水壶订单
价格：40英镑
已付定金：10英镑
取货时余款：30英镑
取货安排：收到到货消息时请联系我们
林把订单折好，与中心购物清单放在一起，茶角还要再等几天。

glossary.note: 名词；在本场景中指林为每月住房支出设定的上限。
glossary.example: Her budget allows forty pounds for a kettle.
glossary.exampleZh: 她的预算中留了四十英镑买水壶。

glossary.note: 比较选择：A is preferable to B；需要说明用途或条件，不是永久胜出。
glossary.example: The wider handle is preferable for the team’s needs.
glossary.exampleZh: 较宽的把手更适合团队的需要。

glossary.zh: 预先支付、计入总价的款项；定金
glossary.note: pay a deposit；本例是总价的一部分，与住房里可退的损坏保证金用法分开。
glossary.example: Lin pays a ten-pound deposit when she orders the kettle.
glossary.exampleZh: 林订水壶时付了十英镑定金。

externalEvidence.definition: a partial payment made at the time of purchase; the balance to be paid later

glossary.zh: 向人收取商品或服务的费用
glossary.note: charge someone an amount for something；本例为动词，与费用名词charge分开。
glossary.example: The shop charges five pounds for delivery.
glossary.exampleZh: 商店收取五英镑配送费。

externalEvidence.definition: set or ask for a certain price

glossary.note: 原资料支付工具词项；故事中这家虚构店接受此支付方式。
glossary.example: Lin pays the deposit by credit card.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the first payment and what remains to be paid.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明第一笔付款以及剩余需付的钱。
acceptableAnswers: Lin pays a ten-pound deposit. The remaining thirty pounds is due when she collects the kettle.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Ask whether delivery costs extra and explain how Lin pays.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 询问送货是否另收费，并说明林的支付方式。
acceptableAnswers: Do you charge extra for delivery? Lin pays the deposit by credit card.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain Lin’s price limit and why she chooses this model.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 解释林的价格上限及选择该型号的原因。
acceptableAnswers: Her budget is forty pounds. The wider handle is preferable for the team’s needs.

transferPrompt.cue: You order a table that arrives next week. Ask whether you must pay part of the price now and whether delivery has an extra cost.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你订的桌子下周到货。询问是否现在需付部分货款，以及送货是否另收费。
acceptableAnswers: Do I need to pay a deposit now? Do you charge extra for delivery?
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
